name: Modern SEO - M4L2 Local Business Networking Strategies
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO - Module 4 Client Acquisition and Pricing](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-4-client-acquisition-and-pricing) | [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Networking (4:28) works when you give immediate, tangible value before asking for anything. "Most people approach networking backwards." The value is a free rank map analysis sent with a few specific fixes. It "builds credibility through results, not through claims."

# Key concepts
- **In person:** Chamber of Commerce meetups, industry events, business improvement district events, rotary meetings. Get owners talking about their business, challenges and competition; listen more than you speak; do not pitch. Collect only the business name and location.
- **After the event:** run a local rank map and email it with a few fixes they can do right away (homepage title tag or H1, add GBP services, fix an address inconsistency).
- **Online:** local business Facebook groups, r/smallbusiness, city subreddits. When an owner posts about visibility or calls and gives name, location and service type, reply with the rank map image and specific advice.
- **No follow-up pressure.** Contact details go in the email or profile; people reach out when ready.
- **Why it works:** visual, business-specific proof; positions you as helpful, not pushy; leads to referrals.
- **Trade-off:** costs only time (a few minutes per rank map); lead quality higher than paid ads; limited scale.

# Checklist
- Event or community with local owners chosen; no pitch made.
- Name and location (online: also service type) collected.
- Rank map run around the address; image sent with a few specific fixes.
- Contact details attached; no follow-up pressure.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- The free rank map can be TAG's own prospecting tool if Scott wants more clients. Check whether [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) rank projects can produce it before any paid tool such as LeadSnap.
- The three example fixes are a fast first pass for [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) and [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub) ([Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile) services, title tag or H1, address consistency). Site fixes go to Kim as recommendations.
- Chamber membership does double duty (trust link from M1L4 plus a prospecting venue) but costs money; needs approval.
- Replies in groups should describe what the map shows, never promise results.

# Caveats and open questions
- No grid size or keyword given for the free map (M1L4 uses primary category + city).
- Posting someone's rank map uninvited may break some group rules; not addressed.
- No numeric results for networking are given.
